mapper.sql: WITH snapshot_history AS ( SELECT ps.SNAPSHOT_NO, ps.ITEM_CODE, ps.ITEM_NAME, ps.MARKET_TYPE, ps.UNIT, ps.AVG_PRICE, ps.MIN_PRICE, ps.MAX_PRICE, ps.CHANGE_RATE, ps.SNAPSHOT_DATE, ps.SOURCE_NAME, LAG(ps.AVG_PRICE) OVER ( PARTITION BY ps.ITEM_CODE, ps.MARKET_TYPE ORDER BY ps.SNAPSHOT_DATE ASC, ps.SNAPSHOT_NO ASC ) AS PREV_AVG_PRICE FROM OFT_PRICE_SNAPSHOT ps ), latest_match AS ( SELECT ppm.PRODUCT_NO, ppm.MATCH_NO, ppm.COMPARED_PRICE, ppm.PRICE_GAP, ppm.SAVING_RATE, ppm.BADGE_TYPE, ps.SNAPSHOT_NO, ps.ITEM_CODE, ps.ITEM_NAME, ps.MARKET_TYPE, ps.UNIT AS SNAPSHOT_UNIT, ps.AVG_PRICE, ps.MIN_PRICE, ps.MAX_PRICE, CASE WHEN ps.CHANGE_RATE IS NOT NULL THEN ps.CHANGE_RATE WHEN ps.PREV_AVG_PRICE IS NOT NULL AND ps.PREV_AVG_PRICE > 0 THEN ROUND(((ps.AVG_PRICE - ps.PREV_AVG_PRICE) / ps.PREV_AVG_PRICE) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS CHANGE_RATE, ps.SNAPSHOT_DATE, ps.SOURCE_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ppm.PRODUCT_NO ORDER BY ps.SNAPSHOT_DATE DESC, ps.SNAPSHOT_NO DESC ) AS rn FROM OFT_PRODUCT_PRICE_MATCH ppm JOIN snapshot_history ps ON ps.SNAPSHOT_NO = ppm.SNAPSHOT_NO ), review_stats AS ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, COUNT(*) AS REVIEW_COUNT, ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1) AS AVERAGE_RATING FROM OFT_REVIEW WHERE PRODUCT_NO IS NOT NULL AND DELETED_AT IS NULL GROUP BY PRODUCT_NO )
mapper.select: SELECT p.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, p.CATEGORY_NO AS categoryNo, c.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, p.ORIGIN AS origin, p.UNIT AS unit, p.PACKAGE_WEIGHT AS packageWeight, p.SALE_PRICE AS salePrice, p.STOCK_QTY AS stockQty, p.DESCRIPTION AS description, p.IS_SEASONAL AS isSeasonal, p.SALE_STATUS AS saleStatus, p.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, p.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, lm.SNAPSHOT_NO AS snapshotNo, lm.ITEM_CODE AS itemCode, lm.ITEM_NAME AS itemName, lm.MARKET_TYPE AS marketType, lm.SNAPSHOT_UNIT AS snapshotUnit, lm.AVG_PRICE AS avgPrice, lm.MIN_PRICE AS minPrice, lm.MAX_PRICE AS maxPrice, lm.CHANGE_RATE AS changeRate, lm.SNAPSHOT_DATE AS snapshotDate, lm.SOURCE_NAME AS sourceName, lm.MATCH_NO AS matchNo, lm.COMPARED_PRICE AS comparedPrice, lm.PRICE_GAP AS priceGap, lm.SAVING_RATE AS savingRate, lm.BADGE_TYPE AS badgeType, NVL(rs.REVIEW_COUNT, 0) AS reviewCount, NVL(rs.AVERAGE_RATING, 0) AS averageRating FROM OFT_PRODUCT p JOIN OFT_PRODUCT_CATEGORY c ON c.CATEGORY_NO = p.CATEGORY_NO LEFT JOIN latest_match lm ON lm.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO AND lm.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN review_stats rs ON rs.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO WHERE p.SALE_STATUS = 'SELLING' ORDER BY NVL(lm.SAVING_RATE, 0) DESC, p.CREATED_AT DESC, p.PRODUCT_NO DESC

SELECT p.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, p.CATEGORY_NO AS categoryNo, c.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, p.ORIGIN AS origin, p.UNIT AS unit, p.PACKAGE_WEIGHT AS packageWeight, p.SALE_PRICE AS salePrice, p.STOCK_QTY AS stockQty, p.DESCRIPTION AS description, p.IS_SEASONAL AS isSeasonal, p.SALE_STATUS AS saleStatus, p.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, p.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, lm.SNAPSHOT_NO AS snapshotNo, lm.ITEM_CODE AS itemCode, lm.ITEM_NAME AS itemName, lm.MARKET_TYPE AS marketType, lm.SNAPSHOT_UNIT AS snapshotUnit, lm.AVG_PRICE AS avgPrice, lm.MIN_PRICE AS minPrice, lm.MAX_PRICE AS maxPrice, lm.CHANGE_RATE AS changeRate, lm.SNAPSHOT_DATE AS snapshotDate, lm.SOURCE_NAME AS sourceName, lm.MATCH_NO AS matchNo, lm.COMPARED_PRICE AS comparedPrice, lm.PRICE_GAP AS priceGap, lm.SAVING_RATE AS savingRate, lm.BADGE_TYPE AS badgeType, NVL(rs.REVIEW_COUNT, 0) AS reviewCount, NVL(rs.AVERAGE_RATING, 0) AS averageRating FROM OFT_PRODUCT p JOIN OFT_PRODUCT_CATEGORY c ON c.CATEGORY_NO = p.CATEGORY_NO LEFT JOIN latest_match lm ON lm.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO AND lm.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN review_stats rs ON rs.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO WHERE p.PRODUCT_NO = #{_parameter}

SELECT IMAGE_NO AS imageNo, IMAGE_NAME AS imageName, IMAGE_EXT AS imageExt, MIME_TYPE AS mimeType, IMAGE_SIZE AS imageSize, SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder, IS_MAIN AS isMain FROM OFT_PRODUCT_IMAGE WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{_parameter} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC, IMAGE_NO ASC

SELECT prm.MAP_NO AS mapNo, r.RECIPE_NO AS recipeNo, r.RECIPE_NAME AS recipeName, r.DESCRIPTION AS description, r.COOK_TIME AS cookTime, r.DIFFICULTY AS difficulty, prm.MATCH_SCORE AS matchScore, r.IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl FROM OFT_PRODUCT_RECIPE_MAP prm JOIN OFT_RECIPE r ON r.RECIPE_NO = prm.RECIPE_NO WHERE prm.PRODUCT_NO = #{_parameter} ORDER BY prm.MATCH_SCORE DESC NULLS LAST, r.RECIPE_NO ASC

SELECT r.REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, r.USER_NO AS userNo, u.NICKNAME AS author, r.RATING AS rating, r.CONTENT AS content, r.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM OFT_REVIEW r JOIN OFT_USERS u ON u.USER_NO = r.USER_NO WHERE r.PRODUCT_NO = #{_parameter} AND r.DELETED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC, r.REVIEW_NO DESC
